- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, conscientious, and plodding individual whose unshakeable nerves keep her from getting easily rattled. She intends to spend her entire life working as a teacher without ever marrying, though she harbors a desire for wealth and luxury items like diamonds.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane Andrews was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who joined the story club organized by [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md) to cultivate their imaginations. As she grew older, Jane joined [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) on a trip to a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where she enjoyed supper with her friends following the show and discussed the wealthy hotel guests on the ride home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P9](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0009), +243 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are close playmates and friends. They spend time together attending local events, such as picnics and school activities, and share in childhood amusements.

- Friend of — playmates and close friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P40](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0040)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane is a classmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). In addition to attending school and social gatherings together, they share a friendly relationship where they lend each other books.

- Friend of — classmates who lend books to each other  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002)</sub>

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) is Jane's brother. They travel to social events together, such as when [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) provides transportation for Jane and her friends to and from a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Diana](../character/diana.md) are friends who regularly visit each other and play together. They participate in shared social circles, school events, and creative ventures like the story club initiated by [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Friend of — friends visiting and playing together  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043)</sub>

### [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) is a figure in Jane's community who intervened on one occasion to protect her from harm. He caught Jane by her sash to prevent her from falling overboard while boating on the lake.

- Saved by — caught her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>

### [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--ruby-gillis.md)

Jane and [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) are friends and classmates who spend time together playing on midsummer afternoons. They also participate in common group activities with their peers, including the school story club.

- Friend of — spending the midsummer afternoon playing together  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007)</sub>
